mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (title, writer, content, category, password, email) VALUES (#{title}, #{writer}, #{content}, #{category}, #{password}, #{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET title = #{title}, writer = #{writer}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, email = #{email} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM BOARD
WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR writer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY id DESC
